notes: Approved at the phase-two review gate on 2026-08-22, replacing the fourteen benchmarks approved on 2026-08-20. A strict superset of that set: aime, chess-puzzles and gdpval-aa are added, nothing is removed. deepswe-1-1 and frontier-code-1-1 are mandatory — both are benchmark-vendor-operated sources, and dropping either would leave the main-screen gate without it. Under that constraint only twelve profiles in the whole dataset carry a DeepSWE score, a Frontier Code score and all eight dimensions, so twelve models is the hard ceiling regardless of which other benchmarks are chosen; an exhaustive search over the remaining twenty-one active benchmarks confirms N=17 still reaches it. The three additions therefore cost nothing and buy strictness: every listed model is now measured on math by two independent sources (livebench-mathematics and Epoch's aime), on reasoning by four benchmarks across three sources, and on agentic work by both tau3-banking and gdpval-aa. Adding simpleqa-verified on top would drop Claude Fable 5, so seventeen is where the free additions end. All five whitelisted sources and 8/8 dimensions are covered. Adding a benchmark here never changes a score — dimension scores use every available benchmark; this list only decides which profiles qualify for the main screen.
